expected_level_description: You can: - understand users have different accessibility needs - build user interfaces that meet accessibility standards and fix accessibility issues under the direction of others

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience

You can: - contribute to the work of others - motivate and empower teams - create the right environment for teams to work in, and can identify the best team makeup depending on the situation - recognise and deal with issues
You can: - follow agreed good practice for the team - show an awareness of the importance of team dynamics and collaboration - understand the importance of feedback
You can: - explain the most important principles of modern development standards and how they apply to your work - apply modern development standards principles under guidance

You can: - collaborate with others to understand and review software requirements - design, code, test, correct and document user interfaces using the right standards and tools under the direction of others
You can: - understand when to use a specific prototyping technique or method - show the value of prototyping to your team
You can: - explain the strategic context of your work and why it is important - support strategic planning in an administrative capacity
You can: - assist as part of a team in the design of components of larger systems

You can: - show an awareness of how to build static assets from source code - explain how browsers use and present static assets to the end users, and how different versions of an interface can be delivered for different browsers and devices
You can: - show an understanding of user experience analysis and its principles - explain the purpose of user stories and the focus on user needs
You can: - describe the basic principles of web performance - explain why web performance is important - help improve web performance under supervision
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
You can: - explain how health IT systems can harm patients, for example through wrong, missing, or delayed information - report a possible clinical safety issue through the right route
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - treat colleagues, patients, and the public with dignity and respect - follow equality and inclusion policies
